offering_description.value: Blackbaud sells cloud software and payment services to nonprofits, schools, universities, healthcare foundations, and companies. Its tools help customers raise funds, manage donors and finances, run schools, and administer grants and workplace giving. It also operates an online fundraising platform for charities and individuals.

primary_products.value: fundraising and donor management software; nonprofit accounting software; school management software; grant management and workplace giving software; online fundraising software

primary_services.value: payment processing; software implementation; consulting; training

customer_segment.value: B2B: Nonprofits, foundations, private schools and universities, healthcare organizations, cultural institutions, and corporate giving teams; B2G: Public universities and their advancement offices; B2C: Individual fundraisers and donors using the online giving platform

end_markets.value: nonprofits and philanthropy; education; healthcare fundraising; arts and culture; corporate giving

revenue_model.value: subscription: Access to cloud software for fundraising, accounting, education, and giving; transaction or usage fees: Processing donations and other payments through its software and online giving platform; service fees: Software implementation, consulting, and training
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees
